title: Tún brand
notes: This is the project's own identity, already public on tun.community and in the pitch artefacts -- not confidential like a company brand plugin, so private is false. It provides 'tokens' and 'assets'. The assets are the logo, copied verbatim from the public site, plus a square mark and a one-colour logo derived from it by assets/derive_marks.py. Tún and the mark are unregistered trademarks: the code licence gives no right to them, see TRADEMARK.md. Never installed by default: core pins the neutral palette for every build (docs/22-plugin-contract.md), so this plugin is selected explicitly via TUN_PALETTE=plugins/tun/tokens/palette.css. See plugins/tun/README.md for the derivation of all eight slots from the four colours used on the public site, the WCAG contrast table, and how the marks were derived.
